review_objections: Alibaba: Kotlin is primarily a backend (JVM) and Android language. While it can be used for frontend (via Kotlin/JS), it is not a standard 'frontend' term in the same category as JavaScript or TypeScript. It is often categorized under general programming or backend/mobile.
Google: While Kotlin can be used for web via JS/Wasm, it is primarily a mobile/backend language, not a standard frontend tool.
